CREST for macOS (arm64): licenses of the included components
============================================================

This bin/crest was built by the brandonbtm29/crest fork (branch qb/macos, workflow
.github/workflows/qb-macos.yml) from upstream crest-lab/crest master plus the changes described
in docs/WINDOWS.md and docs/MACOS.md, with Homebrew's GCC/gfortran and OpenBLAS on a GitHub-hosted
macOS runner. It is not an official CREST release.

CREST itself
------------
CREST: LGPL-3.0-or-later (COPYING, COPYING.LESSER next to this file).
Source: https://github.com/crest-lab/crest (fork: https://github.com/brandonbtm29/crest)

Built from source and linked into bin/crest (git submodules of CREST, and the CMake
dependencies tblite fetches at its pinned revisions):
- tblite (https://github.com/tblite/tblite): LGPL-3.0-or-later
- gfnff (https://github.com/pprcht/gfnff): LGPL-3.0-or-later
- gfn0 (https://github.com/pprcht/gfn0): LGPL-3.0-or-later
- lwoniom (https://github.com/crest-lab/lwoniom): LGPL-3.0-or-later
- libpvol (https://github.com/neudecker-group/libpvol): LGPL-3.0-or-later
- toml-f (https://github.com/toml-f/toml-f): Apache-2.0 OR MIT
- mctc-lib (https://github.com/grimme-lab/mctc-lib): Apache-2.0
- multicharge (https://github.com/grimme-lab/multicharge): Apache-2.0
- dftd4 (https://github.com/dftd4/dftd4): LGPL-3.0-or-later
- s-dftd3 (https://github.com/dftd3/simple-dftd3): LGPL-3.0-or-later

Libraries in lib/ (shared libraries, unmodified from Homebrew bottles except for their install
names, rpaths and ad-hoc code signatures; exact versions below).
Sources: https://github.com/Homebrew/homebrew-core (formulae gcc, openblas) and the upstream projects.
- libgfortran, libgcc_s, libgomp, libstdc++ (GCC runtime libraries, if present):
  GPL-3.0-or-later WITH GCC-exception-3.1 (GCC Runtime Library Exception).
  https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gcc-exception-3.1.html
- libquadmath (GCC): LGPL-2.1-or-later.
- OpenBLAS (https://github.com/OpenMathLib/OpenBLAS): BSD-3-Clause.

Corresponding source: the fork commit named below (CREST plus the qb workflow), the submodule
revisions recorded in that commit, the dependency revisions in
subprojects/tblite/config/cmake/Find*.cmake, and the Homebrew formulae above. The workflow
rebuilds bin/crest from them.
